## Open findings

### High (4)

- `transcript-no-empty-state` — **TranscriptApp** — No empty state — a session with no events yet is a blank page — `client/transcript/transcript.svelte.ts:103`
- `transcript-plan-raw-json` — **TranscriptApp** — Agent plans render as pretty-printed JSON — `client/transcript/components/TimelineEvent.svelte:29`
- `transcript-prompt-raw-json` — **TranscriptApp** — The user's own prompt renders as raw JSON — `client/transcript/components/TimelineEvent.svelte:36`
- `transcript-tool-failure-reads-as-success` — **TranscriptApp** — A failed tool call is indistinguishable from a successful one

### Med (8)

- `plugins-inactive-copy-overclaims-approval` — **PluginsSection** — The ineligible-plugin sentence names approval as the remedy for six different states — `client/settings/lib/plugin-eligibility.ts:44`
- `transcript-app-story-renders-banner` — **TranscriptApp** — The TranscriptApp story renders StatusBanner, not the app — `client/transcript/TranscriptApp.stories.svelte:11`
- `transcript-dead-end-error-states` — **TranscriptApp** — The two terminal states are dead ends
- `transcript-hardcoded-spacing` — **TranscriptApp** — Every spacing and sizing value is a one-off
- `transcript-no-aria-live` — **TranscriptApp** — Asynchronous updates are never announced
- `transcript-no-design-system-primitives` — **TranscriptApp** — None of the shared UI kit is used
- `transcript-no-focus-visible` — **TranscriptApp** — No focus, hover, or cursor styling on the only interactive control
- `transcript-no-timestamps` — **TranscriptApp** — Events carry no timestamps — `client/transcript/fetcher-schemas.ts:18`

### Low (7)

- `settings-app-focus-ring-scoped-to-grid` — **SettingsApp** — The focus ring's colour is a hardcoded literal instead of the accent token — `client/shared/tokens.css:39`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-ignores-collapse` — **SettingsApp** — Re-picking the jump menu's current section does nothing
- `transcript-banner-status-undifferentiated` — **TranscriptApp** — Three banner states share identical chrome
- `transcript-dim-text-contrast` — **TranscriptApp** — The longest text blocks use the dimmest text token
- `transcript-no-live-scroll-affordance` — **TranscriptApp** — Live events append with no scroll cue
- `transcript-timeline-rail-invisible` — **TranscriptApp** — The timeline rail is effectively invisible — `client/transcript/components/TimelineEvent.svelte:45`
- `transcript-unknown-payload-raw-json` — **TranscriptApp** — Unrecognised payloads dump JSON to end users

## Deferred

- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
- `settings-app-no-shared-type-scale` — **SettingsApp** — No shared type scale, so every component invents its own font sizes
